card.title: Ceres ke chamakte spots kya alien lights the?
card.hook: Dwarf planet ki dark surface par bright spots nazar aaye. NASA ke Dawn spacecraft ne unke baare mein kya pata lagaya?

detail.real_life_scene: Door se koi bright spot dekhkar uski wajah guess karna difficult hota hai. Closer image aur material ki information milne par explanation badal sakti hai.
detail.central_question: Ceres ke bright spots kis material se bane hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Ceres Mars aur Jupiter ke beech asteroid belt mein ek dwarf planet hai. NASA ka Dawn spacecraft 2015 mein uski orbit mein pahucha. Images mein especially Occator crater ke bright areas ne attention attract ki. Distance se woh chhote luminous dots jaise dikh sakte the.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Spacecraft ne surface se reflected light study ki. Different materials light ko different ways mein reflect ya absorb karte hain, isliye light ka analysis composition ka clue deta hai. Later Dawn results ke mutabik kuch striking bright deposits mainly sodium carbonate jaise salts se bane hain. Yeh deposits surface ke darker surroundings se sunlight zyada reflect karte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Scientists ke models suggest karte hain ki salty liquid, ya brine, Ceres ke andar se surface ke paas aaya aur material deposit hua. Exact histories aur processes ki details par research hoti rahi hai. Bright spots khud light bulbs ki tarah light produce kar rahe hain, ya aliens ki cities hain, iska evidence nahi mila.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Dawn ne crater ke bright deposits ko close-range imaging aur spectrometry se examine kiya. Spectrum batata hai ki material different wavelengths ko kaise reflect karta hai; sodium carbonate-rich salts ki identification multiple observations par based hai. Sunlight reflection aur self-generated light alag phenomena hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Brine ka source aur surface tak pahunchne ka exact route models se investigate hota hai. Ice-rich dwarf planet par salts ka evidence interesting geology dikhata hai, lekin current flowing ocean ya extraterrestrial life prove nahi karta. Spacecraft data ki spatial resolution aur interpretation limitations bhi hoti hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Remote sensing ka matlab bina material ko directly touch kiye uski properties measure karna hai. Spacecraft observations ke saath laboratory tests aur models use karke scientists explanations ko improve karte hain.

reality_check.established: Dawn data ne Ceres ke kuch bright spots mein salt-rich deposits identify kiye.
reality_check.misconception: Bright dikhne wala spot automatically artificial light ya extraterrestrial life ka proof nahi.

card.title: Khasra hawa se kaise fail sakta hai?
card.hook: Ek infected person ke room se jaane ke baad bhi kuch time tak air mein measles virus infectious reh sakta hai.

detail.real_life_scene: School ya crowded waiting room mein ek infection bahut logon tak jaldi pahunch sakta hai. Har disease ka spread hone ka tareeqa same nahi hota.
detail.central_question: Measles, ya khasra, itna contagious kyun hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Measles ek highly contagious viral disease hai. WHO ke mutabik infected person ki breathing, coughing ya sneezing se virus air mein release ho sakta hai. Susceptible person contaminated air breathe karne se infected ho sakta hai. Virus kuch conditions mein air ya surfaces par up to two hours tak infectious reh sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Symptoms mein fever, cough, runny nose aur baad mein rash ho sakte hain. Person rash dikhne se pehle bhi infection spread kar sakta hai. Measles sirf harmless childhood rash nahi: pneumonia, brain inflammation aur other serious complications possible hain. Young children aur pregnant people jaise groups mein severe illness ka risk high ho sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Vaccination measles prevention ka best available approach hai. Recommended doses aur schedule location aur individual situation ke hisaab se check karne chahiye. Vaccine protection bahut effective hai, lekin kisi bhi vaccine ke liye individual protection ki absolute guarantee nahi hoti. Unvaccinated aur immunity na develop karne wale log vulnerable ho sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Measles ka virus air mein persist kar sakta hai, aur infection rash aane se pehle spread ho sakti hai. Isliye crowded indoor settings mein susceptible people ko exposure risk hota hai. High vaccination coverage outbreaks prevent karne mein important hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Possible measles symptoms ya exposure ho toh clinic ko jaane se pehle phone karke inform karein, taaki doosron ko expose na kiya jaaye. Pregnancy, infancy aur immune suppression mein risk assessment especially important ho sakta hai. Vaccine schedule aur post-exposure options local medical guidance se confirm karein.

detail.real_world_connection: Exposure ya symptoms ka concern ho toh health facility ko pehle phone karein, taaki woh safe arrival instructions de sake. Local immunisation programme ya clinician se vaccination status check karwaayein.

reality_check.established: Measles airborne spread ho sakta hai aur severe complications cause kar sakta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Rash shuru hone se pehle infection spread hona impossible nahi hai.

card.title: Zameen mein achanak bada hole kaise ban sakta hai?
card.hook: Kuch jagah underground rock slowly dissolve hoti hai. Surface ka support kam ho jaaye toh sinkhole develop ho sakta hai.

detail.real_life_scene: Kabhi news mein road ya field ke neeche ground dhansne ki photo dikhti hai. Neeche ka process bahut pehle se quietly chal raha ho sakta hai.
detail.central_question: Sinkhole kya hai aur uske peeche water ka role kya hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: US Geological Survey ke mutabik sinkholes un areas mein common ho sakte hain jahan groundwater neeche ki soluble rocks ko dissolve karta hai. Limestone, gypsum aur salt aise rocks ke examples hain. Rainwater soil se neeche jaakar rock ke cracks aur spaces mein enter kar sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Long time mein dissolving rock ke spaces bade ho sakte hain. Kuch jagah surface gradually settle hoti hai; doosri jagah upar ki soil ya rock kisi cavity ke upar bridge jaisi supported rehti hai. Jab support enough nahi bachta, cover suddenly collapse ho sakta hai. Result surface par depression ya hole ho sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Groundwater level changes aur human activities kuch settings mein risk influence kar sakti hain. Lekin har road collapse natural sinkhole nahi: leaking pipe, mine ya construction problems bhi alag causes ho sakte hain. Geologists ko actual site inspect karke cause assess karna hota hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Dissolvable rock regions ko karst landscape kaha ja sakta hai. Rainwater aur groundwater long periods mein cracks widen karte hain; agar upper cover support lose kare toh collapse rapid ho sakta hai. Subsidence ka slower type bhi possible hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Pipe leak, abandoned mine ya construction failure bhi hole create kar sakte hain, isliye sirf photo dekhkar natural sinkhole declare nahi karna chahiye. Sudden ground collapse ke paas na jaayein, area se door rahein aur local emergency authorities ko inform karein. Site-specific geological inspection needed hoti hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Agar ground mein naya hole ya rapidly widening cracks dikhein, area se door rahein aur local authorities ko report karein. Edge unstable ho sakta hai; close jaakar depth check karna unsafe hai.

reality_check.established: Soluble rock ke dissolution aur overlying material ke collapse se kuch sinkholes form hote hain.
reality_check.misconception: Har sudden ground hole ka cause automatically underground limestone nahi hota.

card.title: Microscope surface ko “mehsoos” karke image kaise banata hai?
card.hook: Ek ultra-sharp tip surface ke tiny ups and downs ko trace karti hai. Kya microscope bina ordinary lens ke bhi map bana sakta hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Aankhen band karke ungli se kisi object ki surface feel karne par uski shape ka rough idea milta hai. Atomic force microscope ek very different, tiny-scale version jaisa concept use karta hai.
detail.central_question: Atomic force microscope ka tip surface ka map kaise banata hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Atomic force microscope ko short mein AFM kehte hain. Isme ek bahut sharp tip ek flexible microscopic arm par lagi hoti hai. Arm ko cantilever kehte hain; ise ek tiny springboard ki tarah samajh sakte hain. Tip surface ke paas move karti hai aur tip aur sample ke beech forces arm ke movement ko change karti hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Machine arm ka bend ya vibration measure karti hai. Computer different positions par yeh changes record karke surface ka detailed map banata hai. Kuch instruments mein reflected light is tiny movement ko detect karne mein help karti hai. Suitable conditions mein AFM individual atoms ke scale ki features resolve kar sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: 1986 mein Gerd Binnig, Calvin Quate aur Christoph Gerber ne atomic force microscope describe kiya. AFM ki image ordinary camera ki photo nahi: yeh measured interaction se reconstructed map hoti hai. Tip ki shape, scanning conditions aur sample properties result ko affect kar sakti hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: AFM optical camera ki jagah tip aur surface ke forces measure karta hai. Cantilever bend ya oscillation ki position-dependent readings se instrument surface ka map reconstruct karta hai; contact aur non-contact jaise modes alag interaction conditions use karte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: AFM conducting aur suitable nonconducting samples dono par use ho sakta hai, unlike scanning tunnelling microscope jiske liye conductive pathway important hai. Tip shape, vibration aur contamination image mein artefacts create kar sakte hain. Researcher calibration aur multiple measurements se interpretation validate karta hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Researchers materials, tiny electronic structures aur biological surfaces study karne ke liye AFM use karte hain. Different measurement modes aur careful calibration reliable interpretation mein important hote hain.

reality_check.established: AFM sharp tip aur surface ke interactions measure karke nanoscale features map kar sakta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Har AFM image simple optical photograph nahi hoti.

card.title: Cell ki tiny rotating machine energy-carrying molecule kaise banati hai?
card.hook: Body ki cells mein ek molecular machine rotation se ATP banane mein help karti hai. Itni chhoti motor chalti kaise hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Phone ko kaam karne ke liye usable energy chahiye. Cells ko bhi different tasks ke liye energy transfer karne ke practical system ki zaroorat hoti hai.
detail.central_question: ATP synthase cell mein kya karta hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: ATP ek molecule hai jise cell energy-requiring reactions mein use karti hai. ATP synthase naam ka enzyme ATP banane mein help karta hai. Enzyme ek protein-based machine hai jo specific chemical reaction ko fast karne mein help karti hai. Yeh machine mitochondria ki inner membrane jaise locations par milti hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Membrane ke dono sides par protons, yaani positively charged hydrogen particles, ki concentration aur charge mein difference ho sakta hai. Jab protons machine ke through suitable direction mein flow karte hain, uske parts rotate kar sakte hain. Rotation se machine ke shape mein changes aate hain jo ADP aur phosphate se ATP banane mein help karte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Paul Boyer ne mechanism ka model propose kiya aur John Walker ke structural work ne usko support kiya. Dono ko is work ke liye 1997 Chemistry Nobel ka half share mila. ATP synthase cell ki energy story ka important part hai, lekin cells ATP banane ke other pathways bhi use kar sakti hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Cells ko biochemical work ke liye usable energy carriers chahiye. Mitochondria mein other reactions proton gradient establish karti hain; gradient stored electrochemical energy ATP synthase ko drive kar sakti hai. Rotation aur protein shape changes ADP aur phosphate ko ATP mein jodne ke mechanism ka part hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Machine energy khud create nahi karti: input energy pehle gradient banane mein lagti hai. ATP ka use cells many reactions mein karti hain, aur production multiple pathways se ho sakti hai. Detailed molecular mechanics biological system aur conditions ke according vary karte hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Muscle movement aur many cellular processes mein ATP-related energy transfer important hota hai. Yeh discovery biology aur molecular-machine research dono ko connect karti hai; cells literal battery ya mechanical engine nahi hain.

reality_check.established: Proton flow ATP synthase ki rotation aur ATP formation ko drive kar sakta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Cells ATP sirf ek hi pathway se banati hain, yeh maanna galat hai.

card.title: Fukushima mein cooling fail hone ke baad kya hua?
card.hook: 2011 ke earthquake aur tsunami ke baad nuclear plant mein electricity aur cooling systems kaise affect hue?

detail.real_life_scene: Computer ya engine mein cooling band ho jaaye toh heat build up ho sakti hai. Nuclear reactor shutdown ke baad bhi cooling ki zaroorat kyun rehti hai?
detail.central_question: Fukushima Daiichi accident mein reactor cooling itni important kyun thi?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: 11 March 2011 ko Japan mein major earthquake aur tsunami aayi. Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power station par reactors automatically shut down hue, lekin tsunami ne power supply aur cooling systems ko seriously damage kiya. Emergency response ke bawajood several reactor cores overheat hue aur damage hua.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Reactor shutdown se main chain reaction stop hoti hai, lekin fuel ke radioactive products kuch time tak heat release karte rehte hain. Isse decay heat kehte hain. Agar cooling sufficient na ho, fuel aur surrounding structures bahut garam ho sakte hain. High temperatures par chemical reactions hydrogen produce kar sakti hain; plant mein hydrogen explosions bhi hue.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Radioactive material release hua aur authorities ne protective measures aur evacuations implement kiye. Impacts ko accurate samajhne ke liye radiation exposure, evacuation ke health effects aur different time periods ko separately examine karna zaroori hai. Nuclear accident ke consequences ko zero risk ya immediate mass radiation deaths jaise simplistic claims mein reduce nahi karna chahiye.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Reactor shut down karne ke baad bhi radioactive decay fuel ko heat karta hai, isliye continuing cooling essential hai. Tsunami se electricity aur equipment damage hone par cooling fail hui; overheating aur hydrogen generation ne accident ko severe banaya.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Exposure levels aur health impacts different groups aur locations mein vary karte hain. Evacuation aur displacement ke health and social effects bhi separately study karne chahiye. Nuclear safety mein backup power, flood protection aur emergency planning important hain; incident ko ek single-cause story samajhna incomplete hoga.

detail.real_world_connection: Accident ne backup power, flood protection aur emergency preparedness ki importance highlight ki. Health risk ke questions mein official radiation monitoring aur qualified public-health guidance follow karni chahiye.

reality_check.established: Fukushima accident mein loss of power aur cooling ne severe reactor damage mein major role play kiya.
reality_check.misconception: Reactor shutdown ke turant baad heat production completely zero nahi hoti.

card.title: TB hawa se kaise failti hai aur treatment kyun zaroori hai?
card.hook: Lambe samay ki khansi ka cause kabhi TB ho sakta hai. Disease kaise spread hoti hai aur test kyun important hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Ghar ya workplace mein kisi ko persistent cough ho toh wajah infection se lekar other health conditions tak kuch bhi ho sakti hai. Guess karne ke bajay proper evaluation helpful hai.
detail.central_question: Tuberculosis kya hai aur iska treatment kaise decide hota hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Tuberculosis, ya TB, Mycobacterium tuberculosis naam ke bacteria se hoti hai. Yeh commonly lungs ko affect karti hai, lekin body ke other parts mein bhi disease ho sakti hai. Lung TB wale kuch log jab cough ya sneeze karte hain, bacteria air mein pahunch sakte hain aur doosre log unhe breathe in kar sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Har infected person ko immediately active disease nahi hoti. Kuch logon mein bacteria body mein inactive reh sakte hain; ise latent TB infection kehte hain. Active TB mein persistent cough, fever, weight loss ya night sweats ho sakte hain, lekin symptoms person ke hisaab se differ karte hain. Tests aur medical assessment se diagnosis hota hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: TB treatable aur often curable hai. Doctors disease aur drug resistance ke test results ke basis par medicines aur duration decide karte hain. Kuch bacteria medicines ke resistant hote hain, isliye unke treatment mein different drugs lag sakti hain. Symptoms kam hote hi prescribed treatment khud se stop karna unsafe ho sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Latent TB infection mein person usually symptoms nahi dikhata aur infectious active lung disease jaisa transmission nahi karta. Active disease aur resistance assess karne ke liye tests, clinical evaluation aur sometimes imaging use hoti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Persistent cough, fever ya unexplained weight loss ho toh healthcare service se assessment karayein. Medicines ka full prescribed course aur follow-up important hai; regimen aur duration TB type aur drug resistance ke according different ho sakte hain. Air ventilation aur infection-control measures bhi transmission risk reduce karte hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Persistent cough, TB exposure ya concerning symptoms par healthcare professional se contact karein. India mein government TB services diagnosis aur treatment access mein help karti hain. Treatment ke obstacles aur side effects health worker ko batayein.

reality_check.established: TB bacteria se hoti hai; infectious lung TB air ke through spread ho sakti hai.
reality_check.misconception: Har cough TB nahi, aur latent infection wala har person infectious nahi hota.

card.title: Satellite jungle ke badalne ki kahani kaise dekhta hai?
card.hook: Ek jagah ki images alag-alag years mein compare karne se forest aur farming changes ke clues mil sakte hain.

detail.real_life_scene: Agar aap apne neighbourhood ki purani aur nayi photos compare karein, toh naye roads ya buildings notice ho sakte hain. Satellite same idea large area par apply karta hai.
detail.central_question: Landsat satellites Earth ki land surface ko kaise monitor karte hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: NASA ne 1972 mein pehla Landsat satellite launch kiya, jise initially ERTS-1 kaha gaya. NASA aur US Geological Survey ke Landsat programme ne decades se land surface ki observations collect ki hain. Is long record se forests, crops, water bodies aur cities mein changes study karne mein help milti hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Satellite sensors reflected light measure karte hain, including visible aur infrared light. Infrared light humari eyes se visible nahi hoti, lekin sensors use record kar sakte hain. Vegetation, water aur bare land different wavelengths ko different ways mein reflect karte hain. Scientists in patterns ko combine karke maps aur colour images banate hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Ek single image se har forest change ki exact wajah pata nahi chalti. Clouds, seasons, fire, farming aur image resolution interpretation affect karte hain. Researchers multiple dates, local observations aur other data use karke conclusions improve karte hain. False-colour image mein vegetation red dikhna necessarily damage nahi hota.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Sensors land se reflected energy ke multiple wavelength bands record karte hain. Vegetation near-infrared aur visible red light differently reflect karti hai, jisse vegetation indices estimate kiye ja sakte hain. Long-term satellite record land-cover changes track karne mein useful hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Seasonal variation, clouds aur sensor differences interpretation affect karte hain; apparent change ka cause identify karne ke liye field evidence aur multiple dates helpful hain. Satellite pixel ek mixed area represent kar sakta hai, isliye every individual tree ya legal land ownership automatically visible nahi hoti.

detail.real_world_connection: Landsat data forest management, floods aur agriculture research mein use hota hai. USGS data public ko free provide karta hai, jisse researchers aur communities long-term changes explore kar sakti hain.

reality_check.established: Repeated satellite measurements land cover changes track karne mein help kar sakti hain.
reality_check.misconception: Image ka unusual colour automatically pollution ya dying trees ka proof nahi hai.

card.title: Awaaz kaan se brain tak signal kaise banti hai?
card.hook: Hawa ki vibration aapke kaan mein enter karti hai. Brain use music ya kisi ki awaaz ke roop mein kaise pehchanta hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Doorbell bajti hai aur aap bina door dekhe awaaz pehchaan lete hain. Kaan aur brain ke beech kai tiny steps is experience ko possible banate hain.
detail.central_question: Sound waves hearing system mein electrical signals kaise banati hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Awaaz hawa mein pressure changes ki wave ke form mein travel karti hai. Outer ear se wave ear canal mein jaati hai aur eardrum, ya kaan ke parde, ko vibrate karti hai. Middle ear ki teen tiny bones vibration ko aage transfer karti hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Vibrations inner ear ki cochlea tak pahunchti hain. Cochlea ek spiral-shaped, fluid-filled structure hai. Uske andar fluid move hota hai aur sensory hair cells ke microscopic projections bend hote hain. Is bending se cells ke channels open hote hain aur electrical signals generate hote hain. Auditory nerve signals brain tak le jaati hai, jahan sound interpret hoti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Hair cells naam ke bawajood ordinary head hair nahi hain. Different parts of cochlea different pitch ranges ke liye sensitive hote hain. Hearing loss ear ke different parts ya auditory pathway ki problems se ho sakta hai; sirf ek cause assume karna sahi nahi. Very loud sound ya long exposure hearing ko damage kar sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Cochlea ki different locations different frequencies par maximum respond karti hain. Hair-cell bending electrical activity trigger karti hai, aur auditory nerve information brain tak convey karti hai. Brain signals ko interpret karke pitch, loudness aur source position samajhne mein help karta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Very loud or prolonged sound exposure hearing damage ka risk badha sakta hai; volume aur exposure duration dono matter karte hain. Sudden hearing loss, severe ear pain ya persistent symptoms par medical evaluation important hai. Hearing problems wax se lekar nerve damage tak different causes se ho sakti hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Earphones ka volume moderate rakhein aur loud environments mein suitable hearing protection use karein. Sudden hearing loss ya persistent symptoms par prompt medical evaluation lein.

reality_check.established: Ear sound vibrations ko nerve signals mein convert karta hai jo brain tak pahunchte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Hair cells ka matlab kaan ke andar ordinary baal ugna nahi hai.

sources.title: NIH NIDCD: How Do We Hear?

card.title: Fluoride teeth ke liye useful bhi, excessive ho toh harmful bhi?
card.hook: Toothpaste par fluoride likha hota hai. Phir kuch groundwater sources mein high fluoride ki concern kyun hoti hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Daily brushing se teeth clean rakhne mein help milti hai. Toothpaste ke ingredients aur drinking water ki quality dono dental health se related ho sakte hain.
detail.central_question: Fluoride ki useful aur harmful exposures mein kya difference hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Fluoride ek naturally occurring substance hai jo water aur certain dental products mein mil sakta hai. Appropriate fluoride use tooth decay, yaani daanton mein cavities banne, ka risk kam karne mein help karta hai. Fluoride enamel, teeth ki outer protective layer, ko acid damage se recover karne mein support karta hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Lekin long time tak excessive fluoride intake harmful ho sakta hai. WHO ke mutabik naturally high-fluoride groundwater kuch communities mein major source hai. Developing teeth ke during excessive exposure dental fluorosis, yaani enamel par changes, cause kar sakta hai. Bahut high long-term exposure bones aur joints ko bhi affect kar sakta hai, jise skeletal fluorosis kehte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Dose, exposure duration aur age important hain. Isliye fluoride ka hona alone harm prove nahi karta, aur zyada fluoride automatically better bhi nahi. Drinking-water source ki proper testing se concentration pata chalti hai. Different sources aur individual conditions ke hisaab se local health guidance relevant hoti hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Fluoride enamel ke remineralisation ko support karta hai aur acid attack ke against resistance increase kar sakta hai. Dental products aur drinking water ke exposure sources alag hain; total intake, age aur duration risk-benefit analysis mein important hote hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Naturally high-fluoride groundwater ka reliable testing zaroori hai. Children ke toothpaste use aur amount ke liye local dental guidance follow karein, aur swallowing minimise karein. Excess fluoride exposure serious ho sakti hai, but appropriate recommended use aur unsafe high dose ko same nahi samajhna chahiye.

detail.real_world_connection: Water safety concern ho toh local public-health authority ya accredited laboratory se test aur suitable water source ke baare mein poochhein. Children ke toothpaste use ke liye dentist ya local health guidance follow karein, aur toothpaste intentionally swallow na karein.

reality_check.established: Appropriate fluoride cavity prevention mein useful ho sakta hai; excessive long-term intake fluorosis cause kar sakti hai.
reality_check.misconception: “Fluoride hamesha harmful” aur “jitna zyada utna better” dono oversimplified claims hain.

card.title: Groundwater pumping se poora shehar dheere-dheere dhans sakta hai?
card.hook: Water level girne par underground sediments compress ho sakte hain. Surface ka effect buildings aur roads tak kaise pahunchta hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Kabhi old building tilted dikhti hai ya road uneven ho jaati hai. Iski multiple possible reasons hain; kuch cities mein ground ka slow sinking bhi ek factor hai.
detail.central_question: Groundwater nikalne aur land subsidence ka kya connection hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: US Geological Survey ne Mexico City mein long-term groundwater extraction se significant land subsidence document ki hai. Subsidence ka matlab ground surface ka dheere-dheere neeche jaana hai. Isse buildings, roads aur water infrastructure damage ho sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Groundwater rock aur soil ke pores, yaani tiny spaces, mein hota hai. Pumping se water pressure reduce hone par underground sediments ka weight zyada directly grains par aa sakta hai. Kuch soft layers compress hoti hain, aur surface level neeche ja sakta hai. Different areas different rates se sink karein toh structures tilt ya crack ho sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Har well pumping se damaging subsidence nahi hoti. Local geology, pumping amount aur groundwater recharge matter karte hain. Kuch compaction permanent ya largely irreversible ho sakti hai, isliye sirf water level recover karne se ground hamesha original height par nahi lautti. Sinkhole aur broad regional subsidence related topics hain, but identical processes nahi.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Pumping se groundwater pressure ghatne par compressible clay layers consolidate ho sakti hain. Yeh process broad area mein slow aur uneven ho sakta hai, jisse pipelines, drainage aur buildings par stress aata hai. Satellite radar aur ground surveys movement map karne mein help karte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Aquifer storage aur recharge manage karna risk reduce kar sakta hai, but compacted fine sediments hamesha recover nahi karte. Subsidence flood risk bhi worsen kar sakti hai. Ek sudden sinkhole aur city-wide gradual settling different mechanisms hain, although groundwater changes dono contexts mein relevant ho sakte hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Authorities ground movement aur groundwater levels monitor karke water management aur infrastructure planning improve kar sakti hain. Individual building cracks ka cause qualified structural aur geological experts hi assess kar sakte hain.

reality_check.established: Long-term groundwater withdrawal kuch geological settings mein land subsidence cause kar sakta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Har tilted building ya crack ko bina investigation groundwater pumping se jodna sahi nahi.

card.title: Microplastics itni chhoti kaise banti hain?
card.hook: Plastic bottle ya fishing net chhote pieces mein toot sakti hai. Kya small dikhne ka matlab plastic harmless ya completely gone hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Beach ya road par old plastic sunlight aur physical wear se brittle lag sakti hai. Time ke saath uske visible pieces aur chhote ho sakte hain.
detail.central_question: Microplastics kya hain aur scientists unhe kaise study karte hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Microplastics generally five millimetres se chhote plastic pieces hote hain. Kuch chhote size mein hi banaye jaate hain, jaise certain products ke microbeads. Doosre larger plastic items ke breakdown se bante hain, jab sunlight, weather aur physical wear unhe fragments mein todte hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Particles waterways tak different routes se pahunch sakte hain. Researchers water, sediment ya animals ke samples collect karke particles separate aur identify karte hain. Plastic ki shape, size aur material type record karna useful hai. Tiny particles detect karna challenging hota hai, aur contamination avoid karne ke liye careful lab methods chahiye.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Plastic ka small pieces mein tootna complete disappearance ke barabar nahi. Microplastics environment mein aur animals ke andar detect hui hain, lekin particular exposure ke human health effects aur risk levels par research abhi develop ho rahi hai. Sirf particle detect hone se automatically kisi person mein specific disease prove nahi hoti.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Plastic fragments textiles ke fibres, tyre wear aur larger waste ke breakdown jaise different sources se environment tak pahunch sakte hain. Sampling mein airborne lab fibres ya equipment contamination se false results ka risk hota hai, so blank controls aur chemical identification useful hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Particle size, shape aur polymer type exposure aur experimental results affect karte hain. Human tissues mein detection investigate ki ja rahi hai, lekin detection alone exact disease risk establish nahi karti. Waste reduction aur improved capture pollution kam kar sakte hain; health claims ko dose-specific evidence chahiye.

detail.real_world_connection: Waste reduction, reuse aur proper disposal environment mein plastic leakage kam karne ke practical approaches hain. Product ya filter ke sweeping health claims ko reliable evidence se check karein.

reality_check.established: Microplastics small plastic particles hain aur larger plastic breakdown se bhi ban sakti hain.
reality_check.misconception: Microplastic milna apne aap kisi individual disease ka cause prove nahi karta.

card.title: Malaria aur mosquito ka connection kaise mila?
card.hook: Ek scientist ne mosquito ke andar malaria parasite ke clues dhoondhe. Pehle disease ko “bad air” se bhi joda jaata tha.

detail.real_life_scene: Machhar ka bite irritating lag sakta hai, lekin kuch mosquitoes infections bhi transmit kar sakte hain. Har mosquito bite se malaria nahi hota.
detail.central_question: Scientists ne malaria transmission mein mosquitoes ka role kaise samjha?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Malaria Plasmodium naam ke tiny parasites se hota hai. Infected female Anopheles mosquito bite ke through parasite human body mein pahunch sakta hai. 1880 mein Alphonse Laveran ne malaria parasite human blood mein observe kiya. Baad mein Ronald Ross ne India mein mosquitoes ke andar parasite development study kiya.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: 1897 mein Ross ne malaria-infected patient ka blood feed karne wale mosquitoes ke tissues mein parasite stages identify kiye. Bird malaria par unke later experiments ne mosquito transmission samajhne mein bhi help ki. Ross ko malaria research ke liye 1902 Medicine Nobel mila; Laveran ko parasite discoveries ke liye 1907 Nobel diya gaya.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Human malaria transmission ko fully establish karne mein Giovanni Battista Grassi aur other researchers ka bhi important contribution tha. Mosquito aur parasite dono lifecycle ke different stages mein role play karte hain. Malaria bacteria ya virus se nahi hota, isliye treatment parasite ko target karne ke liye choose kiya jaata hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Laveran ke blood observations ne malaria ko parasite se connect kiya; Ross aur others ne mosquito lifecycle aur transmission pathway ko investigate kiya. Human aur bird malaria research ke contributions ko separately identify karna scientific credit aur historical accuracy ke liye important hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Understanding transmission se mosquito control, bed nets aur targeted treatment jaise approaches develop karne mein help mili. Har mosquito malaria transmit nahi karti aur every fever malaria nahi hota. Suspected malaria mein rapid medical testing aur appropriate treatment important hain, especially severe symptoms ke case mein.

detail.real_world_connection: Mosquito nets, bite prevention aur local mosquito control risk reduce karne mein help kar sakte hain. Fever ke saath malaria exposure ka concern ho toh jaldi test aur qualified medical care lein; self-diagnosis par depend na karein.

reality_check.established: Infected female Anopheles mosquitoes malaria parasites transmit kar sakti hain.
reality_check.misconception: Malaria sirf “gandi hawa” ya har mosquito bite se nahi hota.

card.title: Samundar ke andar robots temperature kaise measure karte hain?
card.hook: Floating robots dinon tak ocean mein drift karte hain, phir surface par aakar apna data satellites ko bhejte hain.

detail.real_life_scene: Weather report ke liye temperature measurements chahiye. Ocean ke andar bhi temperature aur salt ka data chahiye, lekin wahan regular observation mushkil hoti hai.
detail.central_question: Argo floats ocean ke inside measurements kaise collect karte hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Argo ek international ocean-observing programme hai jo free-drifting robotic floats use karta hai. Programme around 1999 start hua. Core Argo floats generally ocean ke upper 2,000 metres tak temperature, salinity aur pressure measurements collect karte hain. Salinity paani mein dissolved salts ki amount ka measure hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Float buoyancy, yaani paani mein upar ya neeche jaane ki tendency, adjust karke depths change karta hai. Woh kuch time depth par drift karta hai, phir rise hote hue different depths par readings collect kar sakta hai. Surface par pahunchne ke baad data satellite communication se researchers tak bheja jaata hai. Phir cycle repeat hoti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Measurements se vertical profile banti hai: alag depths par ocean conditions ka record. Core floats poore ocean floor tak nahi pahunchte; specialised Deep Argo instruments deeper measurements le sakte hain. Floats moving water ke saath drift karte hain, isliye woh fixed weather stations nahi hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Floats pressure, temperature aur salinity ke vertical profiles collect karte hain. Repeated cycles aur globally distributed instruments se researchers ocean heat storage aur circulation study kar sakte hain; surface transmission satellites ke through data accessible banati hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Floats har location equally sample nahi karte aur sea ice, coastal shallows aur deep ocean mein coverage challenges hain. Core Argo approximately upper 2,000 metres sample karta hai, jabki specialised floats deeper ya additional biogeochemical measurements le sakte hain. Data ko calibration aur other observing systems ke saath combine kiya jaata hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Open data ocean heat, currents aur climate research mein useful hai. Data forecast models improve karne mein help kar sakta hai, lekin kisi ek float ki reading poore ocean ka full picture nahi deti.

reality_check.established: Argo floats ocean ke andar measurements lekar surface par data transmit karte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Har Argo float ocean ke sabse deep point tak nahi jaata.

card.title: Public key sabko de di, phir message secret kaise raha?
card.hook: Ek digital key openly share ho sakti hai, jabki uski partner key secret rehti hai. Dono milkar secure communication mein kaise help karti hain?

detail.real_life_scene: Sochiye kisi ke paas openly available lock ho, lekin us lock ko kholne ki key sirf owner ke paas ho. Digital systems mein related idea mathematics se implement hota hai.
detail.central_question: Public-key cryptography mein public aur private keys ka kya role hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Public-key cryptography mein mathematically related key pair hota hai: public key aur private key. Public key share ki ja sakti hai; private key owner ko secret rakhni hoti hai. Suitable encryption system mein sender recipient ki verified public key use karke information encrypt kar sakta hai, aur corresponding private key se recipient use decrypt kar sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Encryption readable information ko coded form mein badalti hai. Security ka idea yeh hai ki public key se private key calculate karna properly designed system mein computationally impractical ho. Digital signatures mein alag use hota hai: private key se signature ban sakta hai aur public key se verify kiya ja sakta hai. Signature aur encryption same operation nahi hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Real websites aur apps often public-key methods ke saath faster shared-key encryption bhi use karte hain. Public key genuinely intended recipient ki hai, yeh verify karna important hai; otherwise attacker fake key substitute kar sakta hai. Device compromise ya stolen private key se security fail ho sakti hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Public key share karne se sender encrypted message create kar sakta hai, but recipient ki private key ko protect karna essential hai. Mathematical hardness practical security ka foundation hai; real systems mein authentication, protocol implementation aur device security bhi utne hi important hote hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Agar attacker fake public key substitute kare, encrypted message wrong recipient tak ja sakta hai. Certificates aur verification systems is risk ko address karte hain. Digital signature authenticity aur integrity verify karne mein help karti hai; signature automatically message ko secret nahi banati.

detail.real_world_connection: Secure web connections aur software verification mein public-key techniques ka role hota hai. Passwords, software updates aur phishing awareness bhi security ke essential parts hain.

reality_check.established: Public-key systems related public aur private keys ka use encryption ya signature verification ke liye kar sakte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Public key ka public hona private key ko openly share karne ke barabar nahi hai.

card.title: Sickle cell trait aur malaria mein connection kya hai?
card.hook: Ek inherited gene version kuch logon mein severe malaria risk kam kar sakta hai, lekin do copies se serious blood disease ho sakti hai.

detail.real_life_scene: Bachche apne parents se genes ki copies inherit karte hain. Genes body ke proteins banane ki instructions dete hain; unke versions health par different effects daal sakte hain.
detail.central_question: Sickle cell trait aur sickle cell disease mein kya difference hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Haemoglobin red blood cells ke andar oxygen carry karne wala protein hai. Sickle haemoglobin banane wale gene version ko HbS kehte hain. Aam taur par ek normal haemoglobin version aur ek HbS version inherit karne wale person ko sickle cell trait hota hai. Do HbS copies inherit hone par sickle cell anaemia ho sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Sickle cell disease mein red blood cells rigid aur curved shape le sakti hain. Isse blood flow block ho sakta hai, pain aur organ-related complications ho sakti hain. Trait aur disease same nahi hain: trait wale most people generally disease nahi develop karte, though certain unusual conditions mein problems possible hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Studies dikhati hain ki sickle cell trait severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria ke against partial protection de sakta hai. Protection complete nahi hai, aur trait malaria prevention ya treatment ka replacement nahi. Disease other gene combinations se bhi ho sakti hai; inheritance aur symptoms individual situation par depend karte hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Ek HbS copy aur ek usual haemoglobin copy wale trait carriers ko severe falciparum malaria ke against partial protection mil sakti hai. In regions with historical malaria pressure, this genetic advantage population frequencies ko influence kar sakta tha; trait aur disease ke outcomes distinct hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Protection complete nahi, isliye mosquito precautions aur timely malaria treatment still important hain. Do HbS copies se sickle cell disease ho sakti hai, aur other combinations bhi disease cause karte hain. Genetic counselling individual inheritance risks explain kar sakti hai; kisi person ke genotype ko appearance se assume nahi karna chahiye.

detail.real_world_connection: India mein sickle cell screening aur genetic counselling family planning aur early care mein useful ho sakti hai. Test results ko qualified health professional ke saath discuss karein; kisi community ya person ko stigmatise na karein.

reality_check.established: Sickle cell trait aur disease different genetic situations hain; trait kuch severe malaria se partial protection de sakta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Trait hone ka matlab malaria kabhi nahi hoga, aisa nahi hai.

sources.title: NIH: sickle cell trait and malaria research

card.title: Space telescope X-rays kyun dekhta hai?
card.hook: Kuch cosmic gas itni hot hai ki X-rays emit karti hai. Visible-light telescope se poori kahani kyun nahi dikhti?

detail.real_life_scene: Hospital ki X-ray image aur night sky ki normal photo alag information dikhati hain. Nature mein X-rays ke sources space mein bhi exist karte hain.
detail.central_question: Chandra X-ray Observatory universe ke baare mein kya alag dekh sakti hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: NASA ki Chandra X-ray Observatory 1999 mein launch hui. Yeh space se cosmic X-rays detect karti hai. X-rays light ki ek type hain jo human eyes se visible nahi hoti aur visible light se higher energy rakhti hain. Earth ki atmosphere space se aane wali most X-rays ko block kar deti hai, isliye observatory ko space mein rakha gaya.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Supernova ke baad bachi hot gas, black hole ke aas-paas ka heated material aur galaxy clusters jaise regions X-rays emit kar sakte hain. Chandra ke detectors incoming signals measure karte hain. Scientists in measurements se location, energy aur intensity ka map banate hain aur other telescopes ke data se compare karte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: X-ray images ko screen par dikhane ke liye colours assign kiye jaate hain. Blue ya green region zaroori nahi ki human eye ko actual blue ya green dikhe. Colour different X-ray energies ya intensities represent kar sakta hai. X-rays detect hona alone yeh prove nahi karta ki image mein directly black hole ki surface dekhi gayi.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Earth ki atmosphere most cosmic X-rays absorb kar leti hai, isliye astronomy observatories ko space mein place karna padta hai. X-rays extreme temperatures aur energetic processes se linked regions reveal karti hain jo visible-light images mein different dikhenge.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: X-ray data screen par display ke liye colours assign kiye jaate hain; colours energy ya intensity encode kar sakte hain, human-eye appearance nahi. Black hole ke around hot gas X-rays emit kar sakti hai, but detection alone event horizon ya black-hole surface ka direct photograph nahi hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Visible, infrared aur X-ray observations combine karke scientists ek hi object ke different physical conditions study karte hain. Hospital X-rays aur cosmic X-rays dono radiation hain, lekin observation methods aur contexts different hain.

reality_check.established: Chandra space mein cosmic X-rays detect karke hot aur energetic regions study karti hai.
reality_check.misconception: X-ray image ke displayed colours hamesha naked-eye colours nahi hote.

card.title: Molecules apne partners swap karke nayi cheezein kaise banate hain?
card.hook: Chemists ne ek reaction ko “partner-changing dance” se compare kiya. Is process se useful molecules banana kaise possible hua?

detail.real_life_scene: Building blocks ko todkar naye combinations banana familiar idea hai. Chemistry mein atoms randomly exchange nahi hote; reactions specific conditions aur rules follow karti hain.
detail.central_question: Metathesis reaction mein molecules ke parts kaise rearrange hote hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Organic chemistry carbon-containing compounds ki chemistry hai. Olefin metathesis ek reaction hai jisme carbon double bonds wale molecules ke sections reorganise hote hain. Simplified analogy mein do dance partners exchange hote hain, although actual mechanism several chemical steps ka sequence hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: 1971 mein Yves Chauvin ne ek mechanism explain kiya jisme metal-containing catalyst important role play karta hai. Catalyst aisa substance hai jo reaction ko speed up karne mein help karta hai aur overall process mein repeatedly participate kar sakta hai. Richard Schrock aur Robert Grubbs ne useful catalysts develop karne mein key contributions diye.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: In teeno scientists ko 2005 Chemistry Nobel mila. Metathesis reactions medicines, polymers aur other molecules banane ke research aur industry processes mein useful ho sakti hain. Har specific process automatically pollution-free ya risk-free nahi hota: solvents, energy use, waste aur catalyst selection bhi matter karte hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Metathesis mein suitable metal catalyst carbon-carbon double bonds wale molecules ke components reorganise karne mein help karta hai. Researchers desired product, catalyst stability aur side reactions ko control karne ke liye reaction conditions select karte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Catalyst repeatedly participate kar sakta hai, but practical systems mein it can degrade or require separation. Medicines aur polymers ki production mein route shorter ho sakta hai, yet environmental benefit actual solvent, energy, waste aur manufacturing choices evaluate karke hi decide hota hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Better catalysts chemists ko desired molecules efficiently assemble karne ke options dete hain. Reaction conditions specialist laboratories aur industry settings mein control ki jaati hain; yeh home experiment nahi hai.

reality_check.established: Olefin metathesis mein carbon-containing molecule fragments rearrange hote hain aur catalysts important role play karte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Molecular “dance” ek analogy hai; molecules literally dancers ki tarah decide karke partner nahi badalte.

card.title: Earthquake alert shaking se pehle kaise aa sakta hai?
card.hook: Earthquake pehle hi start ho chuka hota hai, phir bhi kuch logon ko strong shaking se pehle seconds ka warning mil sakta hai.

detail.real_life_scene: Phone par alert aane aur actual shaking feel hone ke beech kuch seconds milen, toh protective action lene ka time mil sakta hai. Lekin system future predict nahi karta.
detail.central_question: Earthquake early warning kaise kaam karti hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Earthquake start hone par energy seismic waves ke form mein travel karti hai. Different wave types ki speed alag hoti hai. Faster P waves pehle sensors tak pahunch sakti hain; slower waves strong shaking produce kar sakti hain. Sensor networks initial signals detect karke earthquake aur expected shaking ka rapid estimate banate hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: US Geological Survey ka ShakeAlert system US West Coast par aisi early warning provide karne ke liye use hota hai. Information electronic networks se rapidly transmit hoti hai, jo seismic waves se faster travel kar sakti hai. Isliye source se door kuch locations ko strong shaking se pehle alert mil sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Earthquake already start ho chuka hota hai: system future date ya place predict nahi karta. Source ke paas warning bahut short ya absent ho sakti hai; false alerts aur missed events bhi possible hain. Warning har country ya device par available nahi hoti. Local systems aur instructions alag ho sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Sensors earthquake ke early P-wave signals detect karte hain aur software later, potentially stronger shaking ka estimate rapidly send karta hai. Electronic alerts seismic waves se faster communicate kar sakte hain, but detection aur processing mein time lagta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Epicentre ke close logon ko alert shaking ke saath ya baad mein mil sakta hai. Warning prediction nahi hai: earthquake already start ho chuka hota hai. Jahan applicable, alert milne par local safety guidance jaise drop, cover aur hold on follow karein; har region mein service available nahi.

detail.real_world_connection: Shaking feel ho toh alert ka wait na karein. Jahan appropriate ho, Drop, Cover and Hold On jaisi local safety guidance follow karein. Preparedness, safe furniture aur earthquake-resistant construction warnings ke saath important hain.

reality_check.established: Early-warning systems started earthquake ko detect karke kuch locations ko shaking se pehle alert de sakte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Early warning exact earthquake prediction ya guaranteed advance notice nahi hai.

card.title: Machine molecules ko “weigh” kaise karti hai?
card.hook: Ek protein bahut tiny hota hai. Scientists uski mass ka estimate lagane ke liye molecules ko charged particles mein kaise badalte hain?

detail.real_life_scene: Kitchen scale sabzi ka weight dikha deti hai. Molecules itne chhote hote hain ki unhe study karne ke liye scientists ko completely different tools chahiye.
detail.central_question: Mass spectrometry molecules identify karne mein kaise help karti hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Mass spectrometry ek laboratory technique hai jo charged particles, ya ions, ka mass-to-charge ratio measure karti hai. Mass-to-charge ratio ka matlab particle ki mass aur uske electrical charge ka relationship hai. Sample ke molecules ko ions mein badalna aur instrument ke andar bhejna analysis ka key step hota hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: 1980s mein John Fenn ne electrospray ionisation develop ki, jisme liquid sample se charged droplets banti hain. Liquid evaporate hone par ions mil sakte hain. Koichi Tanaka ne laser-based soft ionisation method develop ki. Dono approaches ne large biological molecules ko mass spectrometry se study karna easier banaya.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Instrument ions ko unke mass-to-charge ratios ke basis par separate ya detect karta hai. Result ek spectrum hota hai, jisme peaks measured signals represent karti hain. Is data aur other information se molecular mass aur identity ka estimate lagaya ja sakta hai. Ek single peak alone hamesha unique identity prove nahi karti.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Mass spectrometer molecules ko ionise karke unke mass-to-charge ratio ke basis par measure karta hai. Electrospray aur soft ionisation jaise methods fragile biological molecules ko study karne mein useful hain because extensive fragmentation ko reduce kiya ja sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Spectrum ki peaks se identity infer karne ke liye charge states, fragmentation aur reference data consider karna pad sakta hai. Different compounds similar mass rakh sakte hain; one peak alone conclusive identification nahi. Technique clinical testing, proteomics aur chemistry mein useful hai, but preparation aur calibration results affect karte hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Fenn aur Tanaka ne 2002 Chemistry Nobel ka half share kiya; other half Kurt Wüthrich ko NMR research ke liye mila. Mass spectrometry medical, environmental aur drug research labs mein use hoti hai, with careful calibration and interpretation.

reality_check.established: Mass spectrometry ions ke mass-to-charge ratios measure karke molecules study karne mein help karti hai.
reality_check.misconception: Yeh normal kitchen scale ki tarah ek molecule ko tray par rakhkar weigh nahi karti.

card.title: Cell ko adrenaline ka message kaise milta hai?
card.hook: Hormone cell ke bahar bind hota hai, phir bhi andar response start ho sakta hai. Cell surface ka receiver kya karta hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Doorbell ka button bahar hota hai, lekin usse ghar ke andar signal milta hai. Cell surface ke receptors bhi bahar ki information ko internal response se connect kar sakte hain.
detail.central_question: G-protein-coupled receptor signal kaise pass karta hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Receptor ek protein hai jo particular signals detect karne mein help karta hai. G-protein-coupled receptors, ya GPCRs, cell membrane mein embedded receptors ki ek large family hai. Kuch receptors adrenaline jaise hormones ko bind karte hain; doosre light, smells ya other signals se connected hote hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Jab suitable signal receptor se attach hota hai, receptor ki shape change ho sakti hai. Cell ke andar yeh change G-protein naam ke signalling partner ko activate kar sakta hai. G-protein further molecular reactions trigger karta hai, jisse cell ka behaviour badal sakta hai. Exact response receptor aur cell type par depend karta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Robert Lefkowitz aur Brian Kobilka ko GPCR studies ke liye 2012 Chemistry Nobel mila. Kobilka ki team ne 2011 mein activated receptor aur G-protein complex ka structure capture kiya. Doorbell analogy useful hai, lekin real receptors multiple partners aur complex responses ke saath kaam kar sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Adrenaline receptor ke bind hone se receptor conformation change hoti hai aur cell ke andar G protein signalling start ho sakti hai. Aage biochemical cascades cell-specific response create karti hain; heart cells aur other tissues ka response identical hona zaroori nahi.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Many medicines GPCR pathways ko target karti hain, so receptor structure drug research ke liye valuable hai. GPCR family bahut diverse hai; har receptor adrenaline respond nahi karta. Structure ka snapshot mechanism samajhne mein madad karta hai, but cell ki full dynamic behaviour ke liye additional experiments chahiye.

detail.real_world_connection: Kai medicines receptors ki signalling affect karke kaam karti hain. Kisi drug ka use ya dose medical advice ke bina change na karein; ek receptor discovery sab illnesses ka treatment nahi banati.

reality_check.established: GPCRs external signals ko cell ke andar signalling pathways se connect kar sakte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Har hormone ya medicine same receptor aur same response use nahi karta.

card.title: Clouds banne ke liye tiny particles kyun chahiye?
card.hook: Water vapour hawa mein invisible hoti hai. Cloud droplets banne mein dust ya sea salt ke tiny particles ka kya role hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Thandi glass ke bahar water droplets dikh sakti hain. Sky mein bhi water vapour liquid droplets bana sakti hai, lekin conditions aur surfaces different hote hain.
detail.central_question: Cloud droplets atmosphere mein kaise banti hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Air mein invisible water vapour hoti hai. Jab moist air upar uthkar cool hoti hai, suitable conditions mein water vapour condense hokar tiny liquid droplets ban sakti hai. Condensation ka matlab gas se liquid mein change hona hai. Many clouds mein tiny airborne particles droplets ke starting points ki tarah act karte hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: In particles ko aerosols kehte hain; examples mein sea salt, dust aur kuch pollution particles hain. Water vapour suitable particles ke around condense kar sakti hai. Bahut saari tiny droplets ya ice crystals milkar visible cloud banate hain. Droplets grow karke suitable conditions mein rain bhi produce kar sakti hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Aerosols clouds ki brightness, droplet size aur rainfall ko affect kar sakte hain, lekin exact outcome weather conditions aur particle properties par depend karta hai. “More pollution means more rain everywhere” reliable rule nahi hai. Cloud pure water vapour ka visible mass nahi: visible cloud mainly droplets ya ice crystals se banta hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Cloud condensation nuclei water vapour ko tiny droplets banane ke liye surfaces provide karte hain. Rising air cool hone par saturation conditions develop ho sakti hain, aur droplet growth humidity, temperature aur particle properties par depend karti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Cloud visible droplets ya ice crystals ka collection hai, invisible water vapour alone nahi. Aerosols cloud brightness aur lifetime influence kar sakte hain, but rainfall response complex hota hai. Pollution ko rain guarantee karne wala simple switch samajhna inaccurate aur public-health risk ko ignore karna hoga.

detail.real_world_connection: Cloud formation weather forecasting aur climate research ka important part hai. Satellite observations aur aircraft measurements scientists ko aerosol aur cloud interactions samajhne mein help karti hain.

reality_check.established: Many cloud droplets water vapour ke suitable airborne particles par condense hone se banti hain.
reality_check.misconception: Visible cloud ko sirf invisible water vapour samajhna sahi nahi.

card.title: Whale fishing rope mein phans jaaye toh kya hota hai?
card.hook: Ek huge whale bhi patli-looking ropes se serious injury face kar sakti hai. Usse rescue karna simple kyun nahi hota?

detail.real_life_scene: Paani mein floating rope ya net door se harmless lag sakta hai. Marine animals ke liye fishing equipment aur lost debris kabhi dangerous obstacles ban sakte hain.
detail.central_question: Fishing gear entanglement whales ko kaise affect karta hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: NOAA ke mutabik whales aur other marine mammals nets, lines aur fishing gear mein entangle, yaani ulajh, sakte hain. Rope animal ki body ke around tight ho sakti hai ya gear ko long distances tak drag karna pad sakta hai. Injury, stress aur feeding ya movement difficulties develop ho sakti hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Whales ko surface par breathe karna hota hai aur travel karne ke liye significant energy chahiye. Entanglement ki severity gear aur animal par depend karti hai: kuch cases mein wounds, exhaustion ya death ho sakti hai. Researchers recovered gear analyse karke problem ke sources aur possible prevention measures study karte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: An entangled whale ko directly approach ya rope cut karna untrained person ke liye dangerous hai aur animal ko bhi harm kar sakta hai. NOAA ke response networks trained aur authorised teams use karte hain. Gear design changes aur seasonal fishing measures some regions mein risk reduce karne ke approaches hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Rope drag animal ki movement aur feeding affect kar sakti hai, while constriction se wounds aur infection develop ho sakte hain. Cetaceans large aur powerful animals hain, isliye entanglement response specialised training aur equipment maangta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Observers safe distance maintain karke local marine rescue network ko location aur details report kar sakte hain. Rope khud cut karna animal aur rescuer dono ke liye dangerous hai. Gear design changes aur fishing practices risk reduce kar sakti hain, but effectiveness local context aur monitoring par depend karti hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Agar entangled marine animal dikhe, safe distance maintain karein aur local wildlife rescue authority ko location report karein. Rules country aur region ke hisaab se vary karte hain.

reality_check.established: Fishing gear entanglement whales ko injure kar sakta hai aur kuch cases mein fatal ho sakta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Whale ka large size use fishing rope se automatically safe nahi banata.

card.title: Vaccination doosron ko indirectly protect kaise kar sakti hai?
card.hook: Kuch log medical reasons se vaccine nahi le sakte. Community mein immunity ka high level unke risk ko kaise affect kar sakta hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Ek infection logon ke beech tab spread hota hai jab usse susceptible, yaani infected ho sakne wale, naye people milte rahein. Community protection spread ki chain se related concept hai.
detail.central_question: Community immunity ka basic idea kya hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Jab enough people kisi infection ke against immune hote hain, disease ka person-to-person spread slow ho sakta hai. Vaccination directly vaccinated person ko protection de sakti hai aur certain diseases mein transmission reduce karke others ko indirect protection bhi mil sakti hai. Is population-level effect ko community protection ya herd immunity kehte hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Kam transmission se un logon ka exposure risk reduce ho sakta hai jo age ya medical reasons se vaccine nahi le sakte, ya jinke vaccine response weak hain. Required immunity level disease ki contagiousness aur vaccine ki transmission reduce karne ki ability par depend karta hai. Measles jaise highly contagious infection ke liye very high community immunity needed hoti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Community protection absolute shield nahi hai. Local clusters mein vaccination low ho toh outbreak possible hai, even if overall average high dikhe. Har vaccine infection ya transmission ko same degree tak prevent nahi karti; immunity time ke saath change bhi ho sakti hai. Individual vaccination recommendations current evidence aur local guidance par depend karti hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Community protection tab emerge hoti hai jab enough immunity transmission chains ko difficult banati hai. Required level disease contagiousness, vaccine effectiveness aur population contact patterns par depend karta hai; high national average ke bawajood local unvaccinated clusters vulnerable reh sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Vaccines individual disease severity reduce kar sakti hain even when transmission prevention incomplete ho. Immunity time ke saath change ho sakti hai aur different infections ke liye thresholds same nahi hote. Vaccination schedules current local health guidance aur individual medical considerations ke according follow karne chahiye.

detail.real_world_connection: Apne aur family ke vaccine records local health provider ke saath check karein. Vulnerable logon ki protection ke liye vaccination ke saath timely diagnosis aur other infection-control steps bhi important ho sakte hain.

reality_check.established: Population immunity kuch infections ka spread reduce karke indirect protection de sakti hai.
reality_check.misconception: Herd immunity ka matlab har individual ko guaranteed protection milna nahi hai.

card.title: Spacecraft asteroid se takraya—kya uska raasta badla?
card.hook: NASA ne ek spacecraft jaanbujhkar asteroid ke moonlet se takraya. Scientists ne collision ka effect kaise measure kiya?

detail.real_life_scene: Moving ball ko doosri ball hit kare toh direction ya speed badal sakti hai. Space mein asteroid ko deflect karna bhi momentum transfer ka idea use karta hai.
detail.central_question: DART mission ne asteroid ki motion kaise change ki?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: NASA ka Double Asteroid Redirection Test, ya DART, 26 September 2022 ko Dimorphos naam ke small asteroid moonlet se takraya. Dimorphos larger asteroid Didymos ke around orbit karta hai. Yeh system test ke liye choose kiya gaya tha; impact se pehle ya baad mein Earth ke liye threat nahi tha.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Collision se spacecraft ka momentum moonlet tak transfer hua. Impact se nikla material, jise ejecta kehte hain, bhi motion change mein contribute kar sakta hai. Astronomers ne Earth-based telescopes se impact ke baad moonlet ke orbit ka period measure kiya. NASA analysis ne around 32–33 minutes ki orbital-period reduction report ki.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Yeh real planetary-defence technique ka first full-scale test tha, lekin har dangerous asteroid ko same method se easily deflect karne ki guarantee nahi. Asteroid size, composition, warning time aur impact conditions matter karte hain. DART ne target ko destroy karne ya Earth ki taraf bhejne ke liye design nahi kiya tha.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Dimorphos ki orbital period impact se pehle aur baad telescope observations se compare ki gayi. Impact ne momentum transfer kiya aur ejecta ne additional recoil contribute kiya, jisse measured orbital period roughly half an hour se zyada decrease hua.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Test ne ek specific binary asteroid system mein deflection principle demonstrate kiya, Earth-threatening object ko intercept nahi kiya. Real planetary defence mein early discovery, sufficient warning time, asteroid properties aur trajectory modelling critical hain. Har object ke liye same spacecraft aur impact strategy successful hogi, guarantee nahi.

detail.real_world_connection: Early detection aur orbit tracking planetary defence ke essential parts hain. Impact ki chhoti change agar enough time pehle mile toh long-term trajectory par useful effect ho sakta hai.

reality_check.established: DART impact ne Dimorphos ka Didymos ke around orbital period measurably change kiya.
reality_check.misconception: Successful test ka matlab har asteroid threat automatically solved nahi hai.

card.title: Lakdi pathar jaisi fossil kaise ban sakti hai?
card.hook: Ek ancient tree trunk ki shape bach gayi, lekin material stone-like ho gaya. Underground minerals ne kya role play kiya?

detail.real_life_scene: Old wood normally decay ho jaati hai. Lekin agar conditions unusual hon aur wood jaldi bury ho jaaye, toh uski details bahut long time tak preserve ho sakti hain.
detail.central_question: Petrified wood kaise form hoti hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: US Geological Survey ke mutabik Arizona ke Petrified Forest mein ancient tree trunks flood sediments ke neeche buried hue. Low-oxygen conditions ne decay slow karne mein help ki. Nearby volcanic ash silica ka source thi, jo water mein dissolve hokar buried wood tak pahunch sakti thi.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Mineral-rich water wood ke pores aur tissues se guzarti hai. Time ke saath silica jaise minerals deposit ho sakte hain aur original structure ko preserve ya replace kar sakte hain. Is process se fossil wood stone-like ban sakti hai. Growth rings ya cell structures kabhi-kabhi visible rehte hain, although preservation sample par depend karti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Wood ek moment mein magic se stone nahi ban jaati. Fossilisation conditions, burial aur mineral supply ke combination par depend karti hai. Har petrified wood sample same process, exact age ya mineral composition ka nahi hota. Kuch modern silica deposits rapid ho sakte hain; ancient fossil history ko specific evidence se determine kiya jaata hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Burial decay slow karke plant structure ko preserve kar sakti hai; mineral-bearing groundwater pores fill kar sakta hai aur kuch original material replace ho sakta hai. Silica-rich fossils mein microscopic features retain ho sakti hain, though exact preservation conditions sample ke hisaab se differ karti hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Fossil ki age uske rock layer, context aur suitable dating methods se estimate hoti hai; colour ya hardness se alone precise age nahi milti. Rapid mineral deposition aur millions-of-years-old fossil history different claims hain. Fossil collection ke liye local laws aur protected-area rules follow karein.

detail.real_world_connection: Fossil wood scientists ko purane forests aur environments samajhne mein help karti hai. Protected parks mein fossils collect na karein; local conservation rules follow karein.

reality_check.established: Buried wood mein mineral deposition aur replacement se stone-like fossil preserve ho sakti hai.
reality_check.misconception: Har fossil wood ka original organic material completely unchanged rehna zaroori nahi.

card.title: Honey infants ko kyun nahi di jaati?
card.hook: Honey natural hai, lekin one-year se chhote babies ke liye serious risk ho sakta hai. Reason ek bacterial spore hai.

detail.real_life_scene: Family traditions mein honey ko harmless food maana ja sakta hai. Lekin infant ki digestive system adults se different hoti hai, aur food safety guidance age ke hisaab se badalti hai.
detail.central_question: Infant botulism aur honey ka connection kya hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Botulism rare lekin serious illness hai jo bacterial toxin se hoti hai. Toxin nerves ko affect kar sakta hai aur muscle weakness, swallowing difficulty ya breathing problems cause kar sakta hai. Clostridium botulinum naam ke bacteria resistant resting forms, ya spores, bana sakte hain. Honey mein kabhi aise spores present ho sakte hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: One-year se chhote infants ki gut mein spores grow karke toxin produce kar sakte hain. CDC ke mutabik 12 months se kam age ke child ko honey nahi deni chahiye—food, water ya pacifier mein add karke bhi nahi. Older children aur adults mein gut conditions generally spores ko same way grow hone se rokne mein help karti hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Infant botulism ka har case honey se nahi hota; spores environment mein other sources se bhi aa sakte hain. Honey exposure ka matlab baby ko definitely botulism hoga, yeh bhi nahi. Suspected symptoms ya exposure concerns ke liye clinician se promptly baat karna important hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Infant botulism mein spores gut mein germinate karke toxin produce kar sakte hain; affected baby mein constipation, weak cry, poor feeding ya unusual floppiness jaise signs ho sakte hain. Breathing difficulty emergency hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Honey ko 12 months se chhote babies ke foods, drinks ya pacifier mein na dein, including cooked or processed honey-containing preparations unless clinician specifically advises otherwise. Exposure ka matlab confirmed disease nahi, but symptoms par urgent medical assessment zaroori hai. Spores dust aur soil mein bhi ho sakte hain.

detail.real_world_connection: Agar baby mein weakness, poor feeding ya breathing trouble dikhe toh urgent medical help lein. Severe breathing trouble emergency hai. Prevention ke liye local infant feeding guidance follow karein.

reality_check.established: Honey mein botulism spores ho sakte hain; CDC 12 months se younger infants ko honey na dene ki advice deta hai.
reality_check.misconception: Natural food hona har age group ke liye automatically safe hone ka proof nahi.

sources.title: CDC: foods to avoid before 12 months

card.title: Ghoomna band kiya, phir bhi chakkar kyun lagte hain?
card.hook: Aap ruk chuke hote hain, lekin inner ear ka fluid kuch der move karta reh sakta hai. Brain ko kya signal milta hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Bachpan mein gol-gol ghoomkar rukne ke baad room moving jaisa lag sakta hai. Balance sirf aankhon par depend nahi karta.
detail.central_question: Inner ear body ki movement aur balance kaise sense karta hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Inner ear mein vestibular system hota hai: tiny canals aur pouches ka group jo head movement aur gravity se related information detect karta hai. Three semicircular canals different directions mein rotation sense karne mein help karti hain. In canals ke andar fluid aur sensory hair cells hote hain.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Jab head rotate karta hai, fluid ki movement hair cells ke tiny projections bend kar sakti hai. Cells nerve signals brain ko bhejti hain. Brain in signals ko eyes aur muscles se aayi information ke saath combine karke balance aur gaze control karta hai. Pouches head ki straight-line movement aur tilt detect karne mein help karti hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Rapid spinning ke baad suddenly rukne par fluid kuch time tak move karta reh sakta hai. Isse movement ka signal aur actual visual information temporarily mismatch ho sakte hain, jisse dizziness feel ho sakti hai. Lekin dizziness ke many other causes bhi hote hain; spinning analogy sab medical cases explain nahi karti.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Semicircular canals rotation detect karti hain, while otolith organs acceleration aur head tilt information provide karte hain. Spinning ke baad fluid movement briefly continue kar sakti hai aur brain ko visual information se mismatch milta hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Spinning-related short-lived dizziness aur illness-related vertigo identical nahi hain. Sudden dizziness ke saath weakness, speech difficulty, severe headache ya chest pain ho toh emergency care seek karein. Persistent ya recurrent dizziness ke multiple causes ho sakte hain, so professional assessment important hai.

detail.real_world_connection: Sudden severe dizziness, weakness, speech trouble ya other concerning symptoms par urgent medical care lein. Persistent balance problems ki assessment clinician se karwaayein, especially falls ka risk ho.

reality_check.established: Inner-ear vestibular organs head movement aur balance signals mein important role play karte hain.
reality_check.misconception: Har dizziness inner-ear fluid ki same problem se nahi hoti.

sources.title: NIH NIDCD: hearing and balance research

card.title: Cell unwanted protein par “delete” tag kaise lagati hai?
card.hook: Cell ke paas protein ko mark karke breakdown machine tak bhejne ka system hai. Label aur recycling station kaise kaam karte hain?

detail.real_life_scene: Office mein outdated files ko disposal label lagakar remove kiya ja sakta hai. Cells bhi some unwanted proteins ko identify karke controlled way mein break down karti hain.
detail.central_question: Ubiquitin aur proteasome protein disposal mein kya karte hain?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
