explanation.text: Proteins cells ke tools aur building components hain. Damaged ya no-longer-needed proteins ka timely removal important hai. Ubiquitin ek small protein hai jo specific target proteins se attach ho sakta hai. Enzymes ki teams help karti hain decide karne mein ki kaunsa protein kis tarah label hoga.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: Often multiple ubiquitin molecules ki chain target protein par lagti hai. Proteasome naam ki cellular machine aise tagged proteins ko recognise karke unfold aur small pieces mein break down kar sakti hai. Ubiquitin labels removal ke baad reuse ho sakte hain. Isse protein levels regulate karne aur quality control mein help milti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Aaron Ciechanover, Avram Hershko aur Irwin Rose ko ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation discovery ke liye 2004 Chemistry Nobel mila. Ubiquitin har context mein sirf destroy ka signal nahi hota; different types of tags other cellular functions mein bhi participate karte hain. Cells ke paas lysosome aur autophagy jaise other breakdown pathways bhi hain.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Cells ko protein quantity aur quality regulate karni hoti hai; faulty proteins accumulate hone se function disturb ho sakta hai. Enzyme cascade selected proteins par ubiquitin labels attach karti hai, aur suitable chain type proteasome recognition guide kar sakti hai.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Proteasome tagged proteins unfold aur degrade karta hai; ubiquitin ka use signalling aur other cellular roles mein bhi hota hai. Autophagy larger cellular components ko lysosome pathway se process kar sakti hai. Dono disposal systems related quality control serve karte hain, but mechanism aur targets identical nahi.

detail.real_world_connection: Is system ka knowledge cell regulation aur disease research mein useful hai. Some medicines proteasome-related pathways target karti hain, lekin unka use specialised clinical decisions par depend karta hai.

reality_check.established: Ubiquitin tagging kuch proteins ko proteasome-mediated breakdown ke liye mark karti hai.
reality_check.misconception: Har ubiquitin tag automatically same fate ya immediate destruction mean nahi karta.

card.title: Satellite samundar ka level itni door se kaise naapta hai?
card.hook: Space se radar pulse bhejkar ocean surface ki height estimate ki ja sakti hai. Long-term sea-level change kaise pata chalta hai?

detail.real_life_scene: Ruler ko paani ke paas rakhkar level measure karna familiar hai. Lekin poore ocean ka level monitor karne ke liye scientists ko global observations chahiye.
detail.central_question: Satellite altimeter sea surface height kaise measure karta hai?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Satellite par radar altimeter ocean ki taraf pulse bhejta hai aur reflected signal ke return time ko measure karta hai. Signal ki speed known hone se satellite aur sea surface ke beech distance estimate hota hai. Satellite ki orbit bhi accurately determine ki jaati hai, jisse sea surface height reference ke respect mein calculate ki ja sakti hai.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: 1992 mein NASA aur French space agency CNES ne TOPEX/Poseidon launch kiya. Later Jason aur Sentinel missions ne related measurements continue ki. Different passes aur regions ke observations combine karke researchers global average sea level ka long-term trend estimate karte hain. Corrections aur calibration reliable results ke liye important hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: Sea level har coast par same rate se nahi badhta. Local land sinking ya rising, currents aur other factors coastal experience ko affect karte hain. Global mean sea-level rise mein ocean warming se expansion aur land ice melt ka contribution hai. Short-term waves ya tides dekhkar long-term trend decide nahi karna chahiye.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Radar pulse ka round-trip time distance nikalne ke liye use hota hai, aur spacecraft orbit ki precise position se sea-surface height calculate hoti hai. Instrument biases, atmosphere aur sea-state corrections apply karke repeated observations compare ki jaati hain.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Global mean trend local coastal change ka exact substitute nahi: land subsidence, currents aur tides regional differences create karte hain. Satellite altimetry ko tide gauges aur independent data ke saath cross-check karna useful hai. Ek storm surge ya single measurement long-term trend establish nahi karta.

detail.real_world_connection: Satellite data aur coastal tide gauges saath use karne se changes samajhne mein help milti hai. Coastal planning mein global trend ke saath local land movement aur flood risk bhi consider karne chahiye.

reality_check.established: Radar altimetry repeated observations se sea surface height aur its long-term changes estimate karti hai.
reality_check.misconception: Global average ka matlab har coastline par exactly same sea-level change nahi.

sources.title: NOAA: satellite altimetry and sea-level rise

card.title: Kya Earth ka spin space-time ko bhi kheenchta hai?
card.hook: Einstein ki theory ne rotating Earth ke around ek tiny effect predict kiya. Orbit mein gyroscopes se uska test kaise hua?

detail.real_life_scene: Spinning top apni axis ka direction maintain karne ki tendency rakhta hai. Agar us direction mein very tiny change detect ho, toh external effects ka clue mil sakta hai.
detail.central_question: Gravity Probe B ne frame-dragging effect kaise test kiya?

explanation.heading: Asli kahani
explanation.text: Einstein ki general relativity gravity ko space aur time ki geometry se describe karti hai. Theory ke mutabik rotating massive body nearby space-time ko slightly drag kar sakti hai. Is effect ko frame dragging kehte hain. Earth ke around yeh effect extremely small hai, isliye accurate experiment difficult tha.

explanation.heading: Aasaan shabdon mein
explanation.text: NASA aur Stanford ka Gravity Probe B 2004 mein launch hua. Spacecraft ne Earth orbit mein four nearly spherical gyroscopes use kiye aur unki spin directions ko distant guide star ke reference se track kiya. Predicted frame dragging aur geodetic effect se directions mein tiny shifts expected the.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur uski limits
explanation.text: 2011 mein reported results general relativity ki predictions ke consistent the, measurement uncertainties ke andar. Instrument disturbances aur data analysis experiment ke important challenges the. Result har possible alternative gravity theory ko independently rule out nahi karta, aur frame dragging ko daily-life wind ya physical fluid ke flow jaisa literally samajhna misleading ho sakta hai.

explanation.heading: Kyun aur kaise?
explanation.text: Rotating Earth ki gravity general relativity mein gyroscope spin axis ke orientation ko very slightly change kar sakti hai. Gravity Probe B ne this tiny prediction test karne ke liye precision gyroscopes aur distant reference star use kiya.

explanation.heading: Evidence aur zaroori limitations
explanation.text: Experimental disturbances aur calibration se uncertainty aati hai; 2011 results predicted effects ke consistent the within reported uncertainties. Frame dragging spacetime geometry ka effect hai, Earth ke around literal air ya fluid current nahi. Ek experiment se every possible alternative gravity model automatically ruled out nahi hota.

detail.real_world_connection: Precision gyroscopes aur space-based measurements fundamental physics ko test karne ke tools hain. GPS jaise applications relativity ke other effects se bhi influenced hoti hain, although Gravity Probe B ka specific test alag tha.

reality_check.established: Gravity Probe B ne Earth ke around predicted relativistic effects ke saath consistent measurements report ki.
reality_check.misconception: Space-time dragging ko Earth ke around normal hawa ghoomna samajhna sahi nahi.
